title: Junior System Administrator - Desktop Support
description: Job Description –System Administrator Professional Summary We are looking for an System Administrator with a minimum of 2 years of experience in desktop support, hardware troubleshooting, software installation, and end-user technical support. The candidate should be comfortable handling day-to-day IT support requests, troubleshooting desktop/laptop issues, configuring systems and peripherals, and providing timely support to employees. Key Responsibilities Provide day-to-day desktop and IT support to employees. Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows desktops and laptops . Troubleshoot hardware issues involving desktops, laptops, monitors, keyboards, mice, and other peripherals. Install and configure software, applications, drivers, and system updates. Troubleshoot MS Outlook, email, and other office applications . Install and configure printers and scanners , including driver installation and troubleshooting. Provide basic support for LAN, Wi-Fi, IP configuration, and network connectivity issues. Provide basic support for antivirus and endpoint security . Troubleshoot ERP, billing, payroll, Tally, and other business applications as required. Provide remote technical support using tools such as AnyDesk, TeamViewer, VNC, or similar applications . Maintain IT asset and inventory records, including desktops, laptops, printers, and other IT equipment. Coordinate with external vendors/service providers for hardware, networking, and other IT-related issues. Assist with basic server, domain, user account, and access-related activities where required. Maintain proper documentation of IT issues, troubleshooting, and resolutions. Ensure timely resolution of employee IT support requests. Required Skills Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in Desktop Support / IT Support . Good knowledge of Windows operating systems . Strong hardware troubleshooting and system configuration skills. Experience with desktop/laptop installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting . Knowledge of printer and scanner configuration . Basic understanding of LAN, Wi-Fi, IP configuration, and network troubleshooting . Basic knowledge of MS Outlook and Microsoft Office applications . Experience with remote support tools such as AnyDesk, TeamViewer, or VNC . Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Good to Have Basic knowledge of Windows Server and Active Directory . Basic knowledge of SQL/database support . Experience supporting CCTV, biometric systems, or other IT infrastructure . Experience working with ERP, Tally, payroll, billing, or other business applications . Knowledge of IT asset and inventory management. Education Diploma / Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field . Relevant IT certifications will be an added advantage. Experience · Minimum: 2 years · Relevant experience in Desktop Support / IT Support is mandatory. Apply Now If you are passionate about IT support, system administration, troubleshooting, and providing reliable technical support to employees, we invite you to be part of our growing team at Evolv Clothing. Interested candidates can share their profiles at: careers@evolvclothing.com Pay: From ₹25,000.00 per month Application Question(s): Do you have experience with Windows, basic networking, IP configuration, and user/system administration? title: Executive IT
description: Job Title: Executive IT Job Summary: The Executive - IT is responsible for the maintenance, configuration, and reliable operation of computer systems, network servers, and (virtualization). They ensure the integrity and security of data, server resources, and systems. The IExecutive - IT will assist and support in the design, implementation, and management of technology infrastructure within the organization. Roles &Resp’s: Install, configure, and maintain operating systems, software applications, and system management tools. Monitor and maintain network stability, ensuring high levels of performance and security. Troubleshoot system and network problems, diagnosing and resolving hardware or software issues promptly. Network Administration: Manage and maintain LAN/WAN infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and VPNs. Monitor network traffic, analyse network performance, and optimize network configurations for efficiency. Implement and maintain network security protocols and procedures to protect data and systems from unauthorized access or breaches. Server Administration: Administer and maintain server hardware, operating systems, and virtualization platforms. Monitor server performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize server configurations for reliability and scalability. Implement backup and disaster recovery solutions to ensure data integrity and business continuity. User Support and Training: Provide technical support and assistance to end-users, resolving hardware, software, and network issues. Train end-users on the proper use of hardware, software applications, and security protocols. Develop and maintain technical documentation, guides, and manuals for internal use. Security Management: Implement and enforce security policies, procedures, and best practices to protect organizational assets. Conduct regular security audits and vulnerability assessments, addressing any identified risks or weaknesses. Collaboration and Communication: Collaborate with other IT Team, departments, and external vendors to coordinate projects and resolve tech issues. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent Experience Proven experience in system administration, network administration, or a related IT role. Strong knowledge of operating systems (Windows,Mac(Linux)), networking protocols, and security principles. Excellent troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently or as part of a team. Additional Information: This position may require evening or weekend work, as well as participation in an on-call rotation for after-hours support. Candidates should demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and professional development in the field of information technology. However, it provides a comprehensive overview of the typical duties and qualifications expected ofan IT administrator. description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your role Employees in this role define and use design documentation, functional programming specifications, and high level design documents to implement identified components. Ensure implemented components are documented appropriately, unit tested, and ready for integration into the final product. Present/demonstrate implemented product features through playback sessions as required. Provide fixes to defects identified during pre-production and post-production phases in the software development life cycle. Provide work estimates for assigned development work. Guide and explain features, functional objectives, or technologies that are being built to interested parties. Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll be in good company among our global community of experts leading the future of mainframe modernization. Experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely. In this role, you’ll design, build and maintain the high-volume business logic that runs on the mainframe. At the same time you’ll play a key role in refactoring legacy code to enable modern cloud and mobile applications to seamlessly interact with the mainframe’s core data. What you will do Maintain Performance: Prevent decay and find efficiencies: Monitor the architecture and identify opportunities to optimize code to maintain and enhance mainframe performance. Debug and Test: Find and fix: Debug, troubleshoot, and analyze complex system interactions to keep mission-critical applications running. Develop for the Future: Bridge the gap: As an instrumental player in modernization, you’ll extract business logic from legacy systems for migration or integration with cloud-based services. Develop and maintain Minder application functionality using established coding practices. Investigate and resolve defects, troubleshoot production issues and provide technical support for associated media business applications. Support integrations and data access across reporting, finance and campaign management systems. Work with business users to clarify requirements and implement changes that meet market-specific media workflows without compromising operational stability. Use version control and structured software delivery practices to manage application changes. Assist with technical documentation, testing and transformation activities for the move to Chase. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. title: Senior System engineer - Patching & Vulnerability
description: Job Description About the Role: We are seeking a Systems Engineer to own patch management, configuration automation and vulnerability remediation across our Linux server and endpoint fleet. This role uses Puppet/Ansible-based automation for Linux OS patching and configuration enforcement, ensuring systems stay compliant, secure, and up to date with minimal manual intervention. Key Responsibilities — Linux (Puppet/Ansible) Manage end-to-end patch lifecycle (assessment, testing, staged rollout, validation) across RHEL servers. Develop, maintain, and version-control Puppet/Ansible modules and manifests for OS patching, software installation, and configuration enforcement. Design staged/canary patch rollout groups to minimize production risk. Automate software installation and configuration across environments to reduce manual provisioning. Troubleshoot patch failures, configuration drift, and Puppet/Ansible run errors across the fleet. Lead remediation of End-of-Life (EOL) / End-of-Support (EOS) operating systems and software — upgrading, re platforming, or migrating affected servers ahead of support cutoff dates. Execute EOL remediation plans in coordination with infrastructure and application owners, escalating and documenting formal risk acceptance only where remediation isn't feasible within the required timeline. Shared Responsibilities — Vulnerability Management & Compliance Prioritize and remediate critical/high findings within SLA. Define and manage maintenance windows, rollback procedures, and exception/risk-acceptance workflows for unpatchable systems. Collaborate with security and application teams to align patch cadence with compliance requirements (CIS Benchmarks, STIG, PCI, etc.). Document processes, runbooks, and standard operating procedures for patch, configuration, and remediation management. Required Qualifications — Linux Minimum 3+ years of Linux systems administration experience (RHEL). Hands-on experience with Puppet/Ansible (manifests, modules, Hiera, PuppetDB, r10k or similar control-repo workflow). Experience with package management (yum/dnf, apt). Hands-on experience remediating EOL/EOS operating systems and software — performing OS upgrades, migrations, or replatforming to bring systems back into supported status. Required Qualifications — Shared Scripting proficiency in Bash and/or Python. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong communication and teamwork abilities. Preferred Qualifications Experience with patch orchestration tools (Red Hat Satellite, Spacewalk, or equivalent). Familiarity with vulnerability management/scanning tools (Qualys or similar). Understanding of CIS Benchmarks, STIG, or other security hardening standards. Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar). Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or higher; Puppet/Ansible Certified Professional. Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare) with formal exception/risk-acceptance processes. Experience running EOL remediation projects at scale (e.g., fleet-wide OS version upgrades, distro migrations) in coordination with cross-functional teams. Familiarity with Ansible or other configuration management tools as a secondary skill. Experience building compliance dashboards (Grafana, Splunk, or similar). Education Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field — or equivalent practical experience.
